metadata.title: fix(security): standardize permission error responses to reduce information disclosure
metadata.author: vishu-bh

description:
## Summary

Standardizes all permission and authorization error messages to use generic 'Access denied' responses for improved API consistency.

## Changes

- **mcpgateway/middleware/rbac.py** (5 instances): Replace detailed permission names with generic messages
- **mcpgateway/transports/streamablehttp_transport.py** (12 instances): Update all permission error messages
- **mcpgateway/main.py** (2 instances): Standardize JSON-RPC permission errors

## Benefits

- ✅ Cleaner API surface
- ✅ Easier permission system refactoring  
- ✅ Consistent client error handling
- ✅ Reduced information disclosure
- ✅ Improved maintainability

## Technical Details

- Maintains HTTP 403 status codes
- Preserves server-side logging for debugging
- Consistent format across REST, JSON-RPC, and MCP transports

Closes #3485

commits.message:
fix(security): extend permission error normalization to all remaining paths

- admin.py: remove permission name leak (admin.user_management) from 403
- main.py: remove session ownership detail and session_id from JSON-RPC errors
- main.py: remove resource subscription detail from JSON-RPC error
- main.py: normalize WebSocket relay RBAC gate to 'Access denied'
- rbac.py: add server-side warning log in require_permission before deny
- token_scoping.py: normalize 'Insufficient permissions for this operation'
- routers/teams.py: normalize all 7 'Insufficient permissions' instances
- routers/reverse_proxy.py: normalize 'Insufficient permissions'
- Update all affected tests to assert generic 'Access denied' message

Signed-off-by: Madhav Kandukuri <madhav165@gmail.com>

commits.message:
test(security): add deny-path test for SessionManagerWrapper RBAC gate

Verifies that handle_streamable_http returns 403 'Access denied' when the
caller lacks servers.use permission, covering the ORJSONResponse path that
was not exercised by existing tests.

Signed-off-by: Madhav Kandukuri <madhav165@gmail.com>
commits.author: Madhav Kandukuri

commits.message:
refactor(security): introduce _ACCESS_DENIED_MSG constant for 403 responses

Define _ACCESS_DENIED_MSG = 'Access denied' in rbac.py as the single source
of truth and replace all raw string literals across admin.py, main.py,
token_scoping.py, streamablehttp_transport.py, teams.py, and reverse_proxy.py.

Signed-off-by: Madhav Kandukuri <madhav165@gmail.com>
commits.author: Madhav Kandukuri

commits.message:
style: fix import ordering in token_scoping.py

Reorder mcpgateway.db import before mcpgateway.middleware.rbac to maintain
alphabetical ordering per isort conventions.

commits.message:
fix(security): address remaining info leaks and add deny-path audit logging

- token_scoping.py: replace server_id and client_ip leaks in 403 detail
  with _ACCESS_DENIED_MSG (server-side warning logs already preserve detail)
- token_scoping.py: normalize resource ownership 403 detail (2 instances)
- main.py: replace hardcoded "Access denied for requested resource" with
  _ACCESS_DENIED_MSG
- teams.py: replace "Access denied to team" with _ACCESS_DENIED_MSG (2)
- main.py: add warning-level logs before RPC token-scope and RBAC denials,
  WebSocket relay gate, and scoped resource access denials
- reverse_proxy.py: add warning log before WebSocket proxy deny
- streamablehttp_transport.py: add warning logs in _check_scoped_permission
  and _check_streamable_permission so all Streamable HTTP deny paths emit
  server-side detail at warning level under default config
- Update affected tests to assert generic "Access denied"

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>

- test_rpc_permission_team_fallback.py: update 2 assertions from

- test_streamable_rpc_permission_fallback.py: update PermissionError match

commits.message:
test(e2e): update MCP RBAC transport test for generic deny message

The e2e test asserted specific permission names ('tools.execute' or
'permission') in the MCP SDK error content text. After standardizing
all PermissionError messages to 'Access denied', the assertion must
match the generic message instead.
